subject: Complete task-level scoping: Add TASK to JohnnyScope enum
description:
Complete the partially implemented task-level scoping by adding TASK to the scope enum in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/pydantic` for schema updates, `/sqlalchemy-2-async` for query patterns.

**Scope:**
- Add TASK = "task" to JohnnyScope enum (formerly MemoryScope)
- Update build_group_id() to support task scope
- Update all scope-related queries to handle task scope
- Update frontend scope filter to include task option
- Implement hierarchical scope queries (task → project → global)

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/johnny_models.py (enum)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/johnny_utils.py (build_group_id)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/context_injector*.py (queries)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/lib/johnny-types.ts (TypeScript enum)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/ScopePill.tsx (UI)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] TASK added to JohnnyScope enum
- [ ] build_group_id("task", task_id="xxx") returns "task:xxx"

- [ ] `dt --check` passes
